690: fn try_convert_to_local_date_time(t: SystemTime) -> Option<DateTime<Local>> {
691:     // Adapted from https://github.com/chronotope/chrono/blob/v0.4.19/src/datetime.rs#L755-L767.
692:     let (sec, nsec) = match t.duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH) {
693:         Ok(dur) => (dur.as_secs() as i64, dur.subsec_nanos()),
694:         Err(e) => {
695:             // unlikely but should be handled
696:             let dur = e.duration();
697:             let (sec, nsec) = (dur.as_secs() as i64, dur.subsec_nanos());
698:             if nsec == 0 {
699:                 (-sec, 0)
700:             } else {
701:                 (-sec - 1, 1_000_000_000 - nsec)
702:             }
703:         }
704:     };
705: 
706:     const NEG_UNIX_EPOCH: i64 = -11644473600; // t was invalid 0, UNIX_EPOCH subtracted above.
707:     if sec == NEG_UNIX_EPOCH {
708:         // do not tz lookup invalid SystemTime
709:         return None;
710:     }
711:     match Utc.timestamp_opt(sec, nsec) {
712:         LocalResult::Single(t) => Some(t.with_timezone(&Local)),
713:         _ => None,
714:     }
715: }
